AirPods Pro 3 is now discounted by another $60, and AirTag 2 has also hit an all-time low. In today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break, we'll first look at the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store, where you can find the lowest prices on MacBook Neo, up to $120 off the price of new units. Beyond the above deals, there's also $500 off this M5 Pro MacBook Pro (that is $100 lower than the pre-price-hike MSRP), plus $150 off Apple Watch Series 11 models, up to $80 off Apple Watch SE 3, up to $130 off Apple Watch Ultra 3, and ongoing Best Buy August back-to-school deals. See below for details.

August AirPods deals with savings of up to $100: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2 and more start at $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)

Official Apple Refurbished Store has the lowest prices on MacBook Neo, up to $120 off the original price

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5-series MacBook Pro, Apple's more affordable brand-new MacBook Neo also saw a price hike recently, but you can avoid that price hike by going through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store — MacBook Neo starts at $689 on Amazon, but at this most authoritative Apple refurbished store, you can pick one up starting at $599 with full Apple warranty coverage.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers the lowest prices on all MacBook Neo configurations, lower than other sources, and from a more reliable source, with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's "rigorous" refurbished quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (originally $699 for new units)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (originally $799 for new units)

Although you don't see any special deal badges on the product pages at the Apple Refurbished Store, all of them are at least $100 lower than the new MSRP — the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 lower than the new original price, and $20 lower than the old original price.

That's right, these are refurbished units, and it's only bringing the price back down close to the old MSRP, but this is still the lowest price on the most affordable current-generation MacBook.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 may not be worth buying a refurbished unit, and that's completely understandable, but this is no small amount of money, and what we're talking about here is refurbished units direct from Apple, of the highest quality.

All models come with:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for purchase of AppleCare
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process certification

If you're looking for an M5 MacBook Air or MacBook Pro, check out the following deals at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, and then take a look at the best new-unit deals we've tracked this week:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 for new units)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 for new units) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 for new units) — $300 off
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 for new units)

Best Buy kicks off August back-to-school deals: Apple products, smart TVs from $80, dorm upgrades, and more

This brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $500 off, $100 lower than the pre-price-hike MSRP, and even lower than Apple's Refurbished Store price

While many of the MacBook Pro deals available right now are just bringing the price back down close to the pre-price-hike MSRP, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is also offering decent discounts. However, this ongoing Amazon discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 2TB model is even sharper — $500 lower than the new MSRP, and $100 lower than the previous much lower original price.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB of built-in storage for $2,499 with shipping included.

The price certainly isn't cheap, but it's $500 lower than the new original price, considering all factors, and most importantly it's $100 lower than Apple's pre-price-hike MSRP.

Another interesting comparison is the official Apple Refurbished Store, which charges $50 more than Amazon for the same refurbished unit.

Nobody likes price hikes, and this deal is admittedly a bit bittersweet, but the fact is the fact — this is an extremely deep discount, in any case lower than the original MSRP.

Details below.

  • 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 from $219 (originally $249)
  • 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 cellular $269 (originally $299)
  • 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 from $249 (originally $279)
  • 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 cellular $249 (originally $329)

Although not all models are back to the lowest prices we've tracked — for example, most models were $20 cheaper during Prime Day at the end of June — the price on that 44mm cellular configuration above is definitely worth keeping an eye on.

This 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 cellular model is originally $329, and now at Amazon's tracked all-time low price, that's $80 off the original price.

Natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with blue Trail Loop sees another discount, Amazon now $130 off

Amazon is currently selling the natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with blue/bright blue Trail Loop for $669.97 with shipping included.

This specific model is originally $799, and the current discount is deeper than what's on offer for other Ultra 3 configurations currently on sale — most of the others are only about $100 off, but Amazon has cut deeper on this Trail Loop combo:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with anchor blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with blue Trail Loop $670 (originally $799)

As you can see above, all other configurations currently on sale are $99 off.

Although we've seen this blue Trail Loop configuration go for $20 cheaper during Prime Day, that was the first time it had dropped lower than today's Amazon price.

Official Apple MagSafe Battery returns to all-time low at 40% off

Deals on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery keep appearing — after briefly jumping back up to its original price yesterday, Amazon is once again offering an all-time low at 40% off.

Amazon is once again selling the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery for $59 with shipping included.

What you're looking at is Apple's own magnetic charger, which costs $99 most other places.

Over the past roughly four months, we've tracked this deal several times, but this price matches the best discount we've seen on this product since Apple launched its iPhone Air accessory battery in September.

Deals started appearing earlier this year, dropping to around $79, with more attractive discounts by early summer, and now here we go again.

As I've said along with many others, this is definitely not the cheapest MagSafe charger, but you also rarely find something with the official Apple logo being so cheap.

That said, this is one of the most elegant solutions, fitting perfectly against the back of your Air and delivering an extra 65% of battery life in an extremely thin form factor.

If you're not so keen on Apple's solution, I usually tend to recommend either the Anker Nano Magnetic Power Bank or the TORRAS MiniMag Power Bank.

Ongoing: Amazon's highest-quality Renewed iPhone 17 Pro $220 off

On Amazon, 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back online, with up to $220 off — these are Amazon Renewed Premium units, with a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and a "greater than 90% original battery life" guarantee. Regular Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and no battery life guarantee.
